label: Claude with Superpowers
install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local; curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local --strip-components=1; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; claude plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace; claude plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace
run: { cat "$SWE_PROMPT"; printf '\nWork without asking questions: no one will answer. Where a skill asks for a choice or an approval, take its recommended choice and go on.\n'; } | claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions ${SWE_MODEL:+--model "$SWE_MODEL"} ${SWE_EFFORT:+--effort "$SWE_EFFORT"}
fired: any(.type == "assistant" and ((.message.content // []) | any(.type == "tool_use" and .name == "Skill" and (.input | tostring | test("superpowers:"))))) and any(.type == "result" and (.is_error | not))
